productionChangesThisRound: Full-width unique row anchors preserve narrow section identifiers that periodic text and sparse overlap sampling previously obscured.
Conflicting or insufficient moving anchors reject weak aliases without poisoning the last confirmed observation.
Short overlaps accept two adjacent distinct anchor rows when nonlocal change supports a near-viewport jump; local-animation protections remain.
Native-window timing fields were added for observation; no speculative focus patch or added delay was introduced.
The ImageBitmap experiment was fully reverted after its actual memory result was worse.

frontendAfterExperimentRollback.productionBuild: passed again in final Wails build

ordinaryScreenshots.inputSpacing: Typically seconds apart with coordination pauses; not a high-frequency burst.

nativeCapture.dpiContext: PMV2 verified against native display mode

originalRoiReplay.scope: Native displacement and export; original ROI includes a footer.

activeMemory.interpretation: Main/GPU partly recover; renderer retention remains observed. This does not establish an unbounded leak or complete memory recovery.

limits: Computer-use Windows Graphics Capture continued timing out despite an unlocked visible desktop. Keyboard/UIA and actual application logs were usable; mouse-drag selection, visual occlusion and perceived animation smoothness were not certified.
The actual native scroll harness invokes the production capture/scroll component. It does not cover the complete Wails overlay hole and selection workflow.
The pixel oracle proves continuity of the controlled selected captured source against independent native-position tail assembly, not OCR semantics or an unoccluded underlying document.
Ordinary screenshot memory/timing observations predate the final scroll matcher. No claim is made that the final executable repeated those complete 30-action batches.
Host/tool load and nonrandom A/B conditions limit latency and memory comparisons. ImageBitmap decoder branch telemetry was not recorded.
No actual local API translation request was made in this round; prior API measurements were not replaced.
No connected Android device was available for real mobile performance verification.
